title: Runtime survives archive failure
purpose: Prove the runtime branch continues when archive delivery is degraded.
verification: deploy the Welkin bundle with an unreachable archive S3 endpoint
POST canonical events through the collector boundary
assert the collector continues to accept events despite archive backpressure
capture branch-separated logs and the drop_on evidence
notes: Archive failure is injected by pointing the archive S3 endpoint at an unreachable address. The drop_on backpressure mechanism on the archive branch must drop archived messages without blocking the economic branch.
